basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I've been a fan of tabletop role-playing games since my college days, and I love watching live-play shows like Acq Inc and The C Team. I have a deep appreciation for storytelling and character development. Outside of my work, I'm an avid scooter rider and often explore the city's parks and trails on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings catching up on my favorite series or designing new board game concepts. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, typically around 9 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in graphic design comes from a mix of formal education with a degree in Visual Arts and self-teaching through online tutorials. I've also gained insights into storytelling and game mechanics from years of playing and watching RPG campaigns.
